title: Patient Priority Portal — Overview
seo_title: Patient Priority Portal — Overview | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Shared truth with regulatory teeth — permissioned networks that survive supervision.

blocks.x: The Achala IT Solutions build of Patient Priority Portal — Overview: concrete interfaces at core systems, measured movement on primary metric, and a delivery rhythm your control owners can plan around from week one.

Patient Priority Portal is the institution-grade DLT platform: permissioned network engineering (Fabric/Besu-class) with governance charters and legal wrappers, tokenization with securities-law discipline, smart contracts built to formal-verification standards, provenance networks for EUDR/DPP-grade traceability, and verifiable-credential ecosystems against eIDAS 2.0 expectations.

blocks.title: Patient Priority Portal — control and evidence planes
blocks.note: What the diagram shows: decisions as first-class records — the decision, its evidence and its owner bound together from creation.

blocks.x: Patient Priority Portal — Overview runs on a structure your control owners can interrogate — the decision plane, the evidence plane and the governance plane stay separate in design and reconciled in operation.

Ledger leads with governance because networks fail on governance, not cryptography: membership rules, data-visibility zones, key custody under HSM, and regulator packs — privacy model, audit exports, jurisdiction analysis — shipped with every network.

items: Events land in seconds, not overnight batches — the precondition for decisions that happen in the moment.
Typed schemas with owners and freshness expectations, agreed before a pipeline is allowed to ship.
Data age treated like uptime — a budget, an owner and an alert when it slips.
Tested, documented models with lineage exposure — the transform layer your analysts can actually read.
Spend per query attributed to the team that wrote it — the meter everyone can see.
Query latency measured at p95 from real workloads — the number users feel is the number reported.
Breakage restored and measured — the repair clock starts at alert, not at someone noticing.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship

items: Unit costs on a published budget with alerts at the threshold — creep is caught by the meter, not by the invoice.
Contracts enforced at the boundary — schema drift fails the pipeline loudly, in minutes.
One definition per metric, owned and versioned — the dashboard and the board pack cannot disagree.
Evidence generated as a by-product of doing the work — audit readiness stops being a season.
The pattern is applied to your estate, not imposed on it — adaptations recorded where they differ.
Decision ownership named per metric — the org chart and the system agree on who answers.
